title: Feature
description: Plan a feature, get approval, build it in a worktree, and check the tests.

nodes.title: Plan
nodes.prompt:
Plan this feature: {{input:feature}}

Read the code it touches first. List the files to change, the approach, and how it will be tested. Do not edit files.

nodes.title: Build
nodes.prompt:
Implement the approved plan for: {{input:feature}}

Add focused tests for the new behavior.

nodes.title: Summarize
nodes.prompt: Summarize what changed for {{input:feature}} in three bullets, and note anything left to do.
